title: Cleveland Heart Disease — hd_data
text: data frame 303 rows 14 columns: HD Heart Disease Status. Confirmed coronary artery disease based angiography (gold standard). Yes = heart disease present; = heart disease Age Patient age years Sex Patient sex. 1 = male; 0 = female ChestPain Type chest pain. typical = typical angina; atypical = atypical angina; nonanginal = chest pain due heart disease; asymptomatic = chest pain symptoms RestBP Resting blood pressure, measured rest, mm Hg Chol Serum cholesterol level mg/dL Fbs Fasting blood sugar. 1 = fasting glucose > 120 mg/dL; 0 = normal RestECG Resting electrocardiogram result. 0 = normal; 1 = ST-T wave abnormality; 2 = left ventricular hypertrophy (LVH) MaxHR Maximum heart rate achieved exercise testing, beats per minute ExAng Exercise-induced angina. 1 = chest pain exercise; 0 = chest pain Oldpeak ST depression, numeric measure ECG change exercise compared rest. Larger values suggest ischemia Slope Slope ST segment exercise. 1 = upsloping; 2 = flat; 3 = downsloping Ca Number major coronary vessels visible disease angiography. Values range 0 3 Thal Thallium stress test result. normal = normal blood flow; fixed = fixed defect (old infarct scar); reversible = reversible defect (ischemia stress)
